name: northstar-assist-lockdown
description: IR containment guardrail: attach to the harness to refuse every request while an incident is investigated. A match-anything regex makes the block deterministic; the denied topic is a second layer.

topicsConfig.name: AnyRequest
topicsConfig.definition: Any question, instruction, request or message from a user on any subject whatsoever, including greetings and company policy questions.
examples: What is the hybrid work policy?

blockedInputMessaging: Northstar Assist is temporarily unavailable while the security team investigates an issue. Please try again later.
blockedOutputsMessaging: Northstar Assist is temporarily unavailable while the security team investigates an issue. Please try again later.

regexesConfig.name: AnyInput
regexesConfig.description: Matches any non-empty text so that every request and response is blocked.
